# Evidence — S04 Action registry — derive, manifest, OpenAPI, MCP, invocation, external ingest

**Project:** S04 — Action registry — derive, manifest, OpenAPI, MCP, invocation, external ingest · **Track:** v1 · **Tranche:** 3 · **Measured status:** built
**Plan:** `docs/plans/slices/S04-action-registry.md` · **Units:** #3
**Measured at:** `main@cc88052`, 2026-11-16

## Claim

One declaration per invocable operation, from which manifest, operation, MCP tool and route are generated, so HTTP and MCP cannot diverge. It replaces the 24 node packages and fr's 88 capability declarations; later slices add actions, never a surface.
